decisions.name: 杜汶澤
decisions.reason: Pixel-inspected 1920×1440 source contact sheet: distant group photograph with many similarly prominent people on a stage. Caption identifies 杜汶澤 as producer among at least eight cast/crew, but does not isolate which small face is his. No credible sharp 600×720 five-feature solo crop without excessive enlargement or mistaken-identity risk.
decisions.caption: (右起) 導演麥曦茵、監製杜汶澤、鍾欣桐、陳偉霆、詩雅、曾國祥、周俊偉、吳浩康

decisions.name: 黃一山
decisions.reason: Pixel-inspected source contact sheet: photograph of an exhibition artwork information placard. 黃一山/Huang Yishan appears as the artist's printed name, not as a depicted person. Zero usable human faces; search name is a false positive. Must not recrop or count as portrait.
decisions.caption: HK Wan Chai North HKCEC China Guardian Autumn Auction preview in October 2023

decisions.name: 廖啟智
decisions.reason: Pixel-inspected source contact sheet: a small 240×457 full-body red-carpet photo. Face occupies only a small portion and is not sufficiently detailed for 600×720 eyes/nose/mouth/chin/full play; would require severe upscaling. Identity supported by Wikidata P18 but visual quality fails.

notes: Do not recrop or reuse these exact source files for the same people; do not remove the people from the release plan.
